title: 小信号分析：电流源激励的流控型电阻
statement: 直流电流源 I_s = 10 A 与小信号电流源 i_s(t) = 0.1cos(100t) A 并联，再与 R = 1 Ω 和非线性电阻 N 并联。N 是流控型的：v = i³（i 单位 A，v 单位 V）。
求 N 的直流工作点、静态电阻和动态电阻，以及 N 两端小信号电压 v_1(t) 的振幅 V_1m 和 N 中小信号电流 i_1(t) 的振幅 I_1m。

questions.explain: 只留直流源：KCL 10 = v/1 + i，v = i³ → i³ + i − 10 = 0 → I_Q = 2 A（唯一实根）。
R_d = dv/di = 3i² = 12 Ω，是静态电阻的 3 倍。

questions.ask: 小信号等效电路中 N 应当换成：
choiceExplain: 对。小信号分量满足 Δv ≈ (dv/di)|_{Q}·Δi，比例系数是 Q 点切线的斜率。
静态电阻描述的是 V_Q 与 I_Q 的比值，不是增量之间的关系；用它会把 V_1m 算成 0.1 × 4/5 = 0.08 V。
只有在 R_d = 0 的段上（如导通的理想二极管）才是短路。
只有在特性水平（di/dv = 0）的地方才是开路。
questions.explain: 小信号等效电路 = 原电路的直流源置零 + 非线性电阻换成 Q 点的动态电阻。

hints: 先只留直流电流源求工作点：KCL 加上 v = i³。
流控型电阻的动态电阻直接是导数 dv/di。
小信号电路是 i_s 给 R 和 R_d 两个并联电阻供电。
solution: **1. 工作点（i_s = 0）。** KCL：10 = v + i，v = i³ → i³ + i − 10 = 0，i = 2 是根（8 + 2 = 10），且 i³ + i 单调，所以是唯一的：**I_Q = 2 A，V_Q = 8 V**。

en.title: Small-signal analysis: a current-controlled resistor driven by current sources
statement: A DC current source I_s = 10 A and a small-signal current source i_s(t) = 0.1cos(100t) A in parallel feed R = 1 Ω and the nonlinear resistor N in parallel. N is current-controlled: v = i³ (i in A, v in V).
Find N's DC operating point, its static and dynamic resistances, the amplitude V_1m of the small-signal voltage v_1(t) across N and the amplitude I_1m of the small-signal current i_1(t) in N.

questions.explain: DC source only: KCL 10 = v/1 + i with v = i³ → i³ + i − 10 = 0 → I_Q = 2 A (the only real root).
V_Q = 2³ = 8 V; R carries 8 A, 8 + 2 = 10 A ✓.
R_d = dv/di = 3i² = 12 Ω, three times the static resistance.
Small-signal circuit: i_s flows into R ∥ R_d = 12/13 Ω, V_1m = 0.1 × 12/13 ≈ 0.0923 V.
Current divider: I_1m = 0.1 × R/(R + R_d) = 0.1/13 ≈ 7.69 mA.

questions.ask: In the small-signal equivalent circuit N is replaced by:
choiceExplain: Right. The small-signal parts obey Δv ≈ (dv/di) at Q · Δi: the factor is the slope of the tangent at Q.
The static resistance relates V_Q to I_Q, not the increments; using it gives V_1m = 0.1 × 4/5 = 0.08 V.
Only on a segment with R_d = 0 (a conducting ideal diode) is it a short.
Only where the characteristic is horizontal (di/dv = 0) is it an open.
questions.explain: Small-signal circuit = the original circuit with DC sources zeroed and each nonlinear resistor replaced by its dynamic resistance at Q.

hints: With only the DC current source, find the operating point: KCL plus v = i³.
For a current-controlled resistor the dynamic resistance is simply dv/di.
The small-signal circuit is i_s feeding R and R_d in parallel.
solution: **1. Operating point (i_s = 0).** KCL: 10 = v + i, v = i³ → i³ + i − 10 = 0; i = 2 is a root (8 + 2 = 10) and i³ + i is monotonic, so it is the only one: **I_Q = 2 A, V_Q = 8 V**.
**2. Resistances.** Static R = 8/2 = **4 Ω**; dynamic R_d = 3I_Q² = **12 Ω**.
**Check:** R_d·I_1m = 12 × 7.69 mA ≈ 0.0923 V ✓; the small-signal current in R is 0.0923 A, and with I_1m it adds to 0.1 A ✓.
